body_lead: Bihar To Establish AI Mission With Assistance From Singapore-Based GFTN The mission will train 7,000 graduate and PG students from STEM and non-STEM disciplines in the next five years. Patna: The Bihar government on Wednesday announced setting up of a mission to establish the state as one of the leading ones in the field of artificial intelligence (AI) and create a favourable environment for it.
